android.desc:
Baby Tracker brings a baby feeding tracker, sleep tracker and diaper log together in one easy-to-use newborn diary. Record breastfeeding, bottles, pumping, growth, health and milestones, and share your baby’s daily routine with caregivers.

Designed by busy parents, for busy parents, it keeps everyday tracking quick and clear—from late-night nursing to the first steps.

WHAT’S NEXT

One more helpful cue for your baby’s day.

What’s Next uses on-device AI to turn recent activity logs into personalized timing cues. Depending on what you’ve logged, it may show:

• A likely wind-down window before sleep
• An estimated length for the next nap or sleep
• An approximate wake-up window
• An estimated time for the next feed
• A suggested time to check the diaper

Cues can start appearing after just a few logs. Regular, complete logging helps make them more personal to your baby’s developing routine.

What’s Next is optional. All core tracking features remain free.

GUIDANCE, NOT A SCHEDULE

Use What’s Next alongside your baby’s own cues and your judgment—not as a fixed schedule or instruction.

What’s Next is not medical advice. Contact a healthcare professional if you have concerns about your baby’s health, sleep or feeding.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

What’s Next cues are created directly on your device. Your baby’s logs aren’t sent to us to generate them.

BABY FEEDING & BREASTFEEDING TRACKER

• Use the breastfeeding timer to track nursing on each breast
• Quickly see which side you last used
• Keep a bottle feeding log for formula and expressed breast milk
• Record solid foods and notes about preferences or reactions
• Review feeding times and your baby’s changing routine

PUMPING & BREAST MILK TRACKER

• Record pumping sessions and milk amounts
• Keep a breast pump log alongside your feeding records

BABY SLEEP TRACKER & NAP LOG

• Record daytime naps and nighttime sleep
• Use the sleep timer to keep a baby sleep log
• Review sleep patterns as your baby’s sleep schedule changes
• Set reminders and alarms
• See personalized What’s Next sleep and wake-up cues

DIAPER TRACKER

• Log wet, dirty and mixed diapers
• Quickly see when the last diaper change occurred
• Keep a diaper log with a clear history of changes

BABY GROWTH TRACKER

• Track weight, height and head circumference
• Follow infant growth charts based on World Health Organization standards

HEALTH & DEVELOPMENT

• Record medications, vaccination

quotes.text:
[UPDATED]

A fulltime father of a 2yr old.  Few bullet points on what I wish I had from the beginning.

1. <5mons tons of skin to skin, lotsa of low calming talk to your baby, soothing music w/o words like works from Claude Debussy, smile/laugh at every chance.

2. <9mons while baby on their back, move their legs like army crawling, lotsa of stomach time.

3. >10mons 2 individuals who seem to contradict, but same messages: (just a few quick potent sound bites)

    - Jordan Peterson : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5cTyxJWZC7k
   
    - *Gabor Mate\ : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcPPDbvGr7s, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9B5mYfBPlY

4. Your child will mimic your every move, talk, and reactions.  They basically are your mini me.  When they say, the are reflections of you they aren't kidding.  The few times I talked aspirated or over excited happy or angry, I witnessed my child re-enacting it later including the few words he remembers.  Kinda scary.  So point #4: you need to change who you are completely.  If you want to raise a calm, gentle, compassionate, humble, caring, empathetic child.  You need to show that in every thing you do.  If your child acts out or "misbehaves" or something you don't approve of.  It's not them, it's you they are reflecting.  Again, you need to show not tell.   At this age and reasoning level, they have ZERO comprehension of  your words, only your tone and body language.

5. Join a dad's group.  Even if you don't receive "support" or …
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Things you wish you knew before having kids?
